episodeTitle.en: Tobi Lütke's leadership playbook: First principles, infinite games, and maximizing human potential
episodeTitle.zh: 托比·卢特克（Tobi Lütke）的领导力秘籍：第一性原理、无限游戏与最大化人类潜能

guestBioOfficial.en: Tobi Lütke is the founder and CEO of Shopify, a $130 billion business that powers over 10% of all U.S. e-commerce. Starting as a snowboard shop in 2004, Shopify has become the leading commerce platform by consistently approaching problems differently. Tobi remains deeply technical, frequently coding alongside his team, and is known for his unique approach to leadership, product development, and company building. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why complexity kills entrepreneurship
guestBioOfficial.zh: 托比·卢特克（Tobi Lütke）是Shopify的创始人兼CEO。Shopify市值达1300亿美元，支撑着美国10%以上的电子商务业务。Shopify最初只是2004年的一家滑雪板店，如今已成为领先的电商平台，始终以不同视角解决问题。托比始终保持着深厚的技术功底，经常与团队一起编码，并以独特的领导力、产品开发和公司建设方法而闻名。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了：•为何复杂性会扼杀创业精神

title.en: Tobi Lütke's leadership playbook: First principles, infinite games, and maximizing human potential
title.zh: 托比·卢特克（Tobi Lütke）的领导力秘籍：第一性原理、无限游戏与最大化人类潜能

summary.en: Tobi shares his leadership playbook: thinking from first principles, treating business as an infinite game, and maximizing leverage by using the best tools and agents available. He discusses why craft, simplicity, and developer happiness matter, and how he approaches strategy and hiring at Shopify's scale. The episode is a masterclass in founder-led, conviction-driven operating.
summary.zh: Tobi 分享了他的领导手册：从第一性原理思考、把商业当作无限游戏、并通过使用最佳工具与智能体来最大化杠杆。他讨论了为什么工艺、简洁与开发者的快乐至关重要，以及他在 Shopify 这种规模下如何处理战略与招聘。本期是一堂关于创始人驱动、凭信念运作的大师课。
